Independent pointwise right-shift check (10,384 mode-coordinate comparisons on even orders 4..24 and four phases), using equivalent positive-exponent indexing and 2 cos(phi−2πk/n): for n=4, phi=.174, k=1 the positive mode has eigenvalue +.3462466483, not −.3462466483. Independently sampled half-flux zero and the bound for the odd primes in this range.
correctness.rationale: The frozen proof assigns 2 cos(phi+2πk/n) to the positive-exponent mode, but the specified right shift acts on column-vector coordinates by (Tf)(j)=f(j-1). The frozen check_fourier_matrix instead evaluates the opposite shift, so its stated check does not catch this. The replacement files use the negative-exponent mode with the original eigenvalue and the target phase ζ^(jk), and the checker now exercises the stated right shift. For the corrected proof, the balanced relation criterion follows from continuous-time Kronecker on frequency differences, including possible degeneracy. The ± eigenpairs force n|2j. For every odd prime divisor p, the two disjoint length-p cosets based at 0 and 1 have zero eigenvalue sums and opposite target parities. Their rotated phase products differ by 2 in modulus; telescoping and Cauchy–Schwarz bound that difference by 2 sqrt(pn(1-|A|)), giving the stated gap. For power-of-two n and transcendental tangent, rational frequency relations split into two algebraic sums, so cyclotomic divisibility by x^(n/2)+1 forces equal coefficients on the paired indices. As n/2 is even, every balanced relation satisfies the antipodal parity test. At exact transfer two eigenvalue pairs would make 4t cos(phi) and 4t sin(phi) integer multiples of 2π, contrary to transcendental tangent. The parity-reversing index involution k↦n−1−k still cancels antipodal terms at phi=π/n. Algebraic tangent values and poles exclude at most countably many phases, also after projecting to total flux. No theorem hypothesis, conclusion, or quantitative constant changes in the repair.
residual_risks: Finite checks are supplementary and do not certify asymptotic PGST. Algebraic-tangent phases in the power-of-two case are not classified. No sharpness or time-to-transfer claim is assessed.

broader_coverage.reasoning: General relation criteria require finding the balanced relations and proving the uniform quantitative obstruction; the primeness, integrality or hub hypotheses of the closest concrete results do not specialize to the frozen claim.

value.rationale: Uniform flux is a natural perturbation of the familiar unphased cycle. The correction preserves a phase-uniform robust obstruction with an explicit numerical margin for every odd prime divisor, as well as the contrast with PGST at almost all fluxes on power-of-two cycles. A qualitative failure at selected fluxes is insufficient for this quantitative stability distinction. The already known half-flux cancellation serves only to show why almost-everywhere cannot be replaced by everywhere.
residual_risks: The cap is not claimed sharp and no effective time estimate follows.
